title: ISO-NE .Z.NEMASSBOST: day-ahead minus real-time by hour

facts: ISO-NE .Z.NEMASSBOST, 2026-10-04 to 2026-10-10: the mean day-ahead minus real-time spread was highest in the hour starting 14:00 local, 7.64 USD/MWh, and lowest in the hour starting 06:00, -12.41 USD/MWh.
Mean spread over all hours, 2026-10-04 to 2026-10-10: -0.55 USD/MWh.
